description: List the standards packs — versioned formalizations of external reference norms (e.g. the EU AI Act) into AIO Framework hierarchy values. A pack is AIO's own formalization of a norm; a Tier 0 measurement against it yields a score report, not certification, and nothing is endorsed by the body that issued the norm. CC BY 4.0.
